lessons.trigger_condition: Frame-level review of the uploaded 2026-10-03 tablet reference recording showed a persistent five-slot bottom navigation with an emphasized central capture action, while the current TCG Grader tablet shell kept a static four-slot dock even though V401-V404 already produced verified screen-neural feature rankings.
lessons.prevention_rule: Keep Home and Capture as fixed safe anchors, select only three additional entries from the exact existing 18-feature allowlist, deduplicate by verified DOM target, and drive those slots only from the validated screen_module_plan ranking. If the plan or targets are invalid, fail closed to the bounded default dock. Never learn from clicks or generate targets, URLs, commands or source code.
validation_required: persistent dock contains exactly five slots with Home fixed first and Capture fixed in the center
three adaptive slots are selected only from the same exact 18 feature keys used by the verified tablet screen policy
duplicate DOM targets are rejected and missing targets fail closed
dashboard passes screen_module_plan rankings only after validLayout validation and restores the default dock when AI layout is disabled
no user click or pointer behavior is persisted or used as a learning signal
no arbitrary URL, command, source-code generation, runtime source rewrite or Git write is introduced
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V407 expands adaptive presentation only. It reuses verified screen-neural ranking output and existing DOM targets; it does not expand execution authority, invent market/grade/stock facts, persist precise location, track user behavior, auto-edit source code or write Git.
